item.title: Eurobites: Ericsson takes rApps onto AWS cloud
item.description: Also in today's EMEA regional roundup: Nokia gets API with Vodafone; LMT expands into IoT space; Ooredoo sprouts fiber unit.

item.title: Optical fiber prices are also soaring on AI demand
item.description: Fiber manufacturing capacity has maxed out due to rise in AI and military drone sales, and prices are soaring.

item.title: Taara's 'Lightbridge Pro' wireless platform targets 20-Gig
item.description: Taara, a free space optics unit born out of Google's X program, has launched 'Lightbridge Pro,' a carrier-grade platform that delivers up to 20 Gbit/s. #pressrelease

item.title: Armstrong cuts deal to acquire MCTV
item.description: Armstrong said it has forged a deal to acquire MCTV, an operator also known as Massillon Cable TV that serves parts of Ohio and West Virginia. The deal will add more than 96,000 passings to Armstrong's footprint. #pressrelease

item.title: Telit Cinterion to present CMB100 demo and advanced eSIM innovation at MWC Barcelona 2026
item.description: Showcasing the CMB100 embedded modem and NExT™ eSIM featuring GSMA SGP.32-ready profile download, swapping and deleting for seamless activation testing. #pressrelease

item.title: Latin America's smartphone market hits record 140.5M units in 2025, up 12% in 4Q – Omdia
item.description: The strong fourth quarter pushed the region to its highest quarterly result on record, surpassing 37 million units for the first time. #pressrelease

item.title: Comcast's quantum leap targets Internet reliability
item.description: Following a quantum trial with Classiq and AMD, Comcast thinks the tech can help drive reliability upwards as its network becomes more complex. Operators will use quantum tech to 'solve niche problems,' says Omdia's James Crawshaw.

item.title: WBD gives Paramount another shot
item.description: Warner Bros. Discovery said it will restart deal talks with Paramount, but the clock is ticking, with Paramount given a seven-day window to make its 'best and final offer' for all of WBD.

item.title: Calix launches AI-native platform for service providers
item.description: Newly launched Calix One platform enables service providers to use secure agentic AI to reach new subscribers, grow revenue and increase subscriber loyalty. #pressrelease

item.title: FCC's Gomez condemns interview censorship
item.description: 'The FCC has no lawful authority to pressure broadcasters for political purposes or to create a climate that chills free expression,' said Commissioner Gomez after CBS declined to air a 'Late Show' interview with a Democratic candidate amid political pressure from the FCC. #pressrelease
